curl is meant to load a url on the command line 
 while -v when added shows more detailed information like Header, redirect TSL/SSL handshake

natas1.lesson: I never added http:// to make it work, however I am yet to find out the reason it wasn't working before with http

natas2.lesson: Sometimes look at the output of curl the clue could be in somefiles hidden there

natas3.lesson: The password or some other special files could be hidden in a location that is not available on the web, the file robots.txt holds those files. sometimes in the process of trying to get that file you could hit another pointer which shows what is available on the web and that is where other files could be located

natas4.lesson: Sometimes you might need to add some header parameter like this one required Referer i.e.  where you are coming from, despite the authentication is correct they still want to know where we came from

natas5.lesson: Cookies that are not cryptographically signed can be manipulated say for instance the loggedin parameter can be changed to 1 to show that you were loggedin before
